analysis.name: Provider-attributed Conduit chevron · dark variant
analysis.description: Chevron symbol returned by Brandfetch for conduit.ai. Current usage alongside the website wordmark has not been confirmed.

observed.composition: Dark chevron centered on a light rounded rectangle. Simpler/smaller sibling of the teal tile mark. Frame appears fully opaque (no checkerboard).
observed.colors: White / off-white field; dark brown to near-black mark.
observed.logo_placement: Centered Conduit mark only. Not a customer logo or seal.

guidance.use_when: Reference inspection only until the brand owner confirms this variant.
guidance.how_to_use: Prefer the current website wordmark for draft concepts. Keep this provider original unchanged and pending approval.
guidance.avoid_when: Do not use as the approved primary logo, recolor it, or assume it replaces the website wordmark.
guidance.crop_and_placement: Do not crop the mark or the rounded square. Keep original padding; do not extract the chevron from the tile.
guidance.background_suitability: Inspect the original on suitable contrast; brand owner must approve actual placement and variant usage.

analysis.inferred_audience: Product designers placing a compact brand glyph
uncertainties: Whether the dark color is true black vs brown is hard to judge at this size.
Provider theme label says dark; the visible file is a light tile with a dark mark.
JPEG delivery may limit clean transparency use.
Provider domain attribution is verified; currency and approved use of this chevron variant are unresolved.
